name: What is luxury property marketing, and how does it differ from standard real estate marketing?

mainEntity.name: What is luxury property marketing, and how does it differ from standard real estate marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury property marketing focuses on showcasing high-end homes to an exclusive clientele, emphasizing unique features, lifestyle, and exclusivity. Unlike standard marketing, it involves specialized strategies such as professional photography and videography, targeted digital campaigns, and discreet networking. For properties in areas like Miami Beach or Coral Gables, this often means highlighting architectural distinctiveness, premium finishes, and the unique lifestyle benefits that attract discerning buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury property marketing targets high-net-worth individuals, using specialized strategies to showcase unique features and lifestyle, differing from standard real estate marketing in its focus and approach.
